items.title: Filtration (print mein doosra 15.1) (chhaan kar alag karna) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Filtration, printed as a second 15.1 with Figures 15.1 to 15.4 and Quick Check 15.1, pages 324-326.

blocks.text: Yeh process do components wale heterogeneous mixture (aisa mixture jis ke hisse alag alag nazar aayen) mein se ek component ko alag karne ke liye istemal hota hai. Pehla step suitable (munasib) solvent chunna hai, jis mein ek component poori tarah hal ho jaye aur doosra taqreeban bilkul hal na ho. Misal ke taur par aam namak (common salt) aur ret (sand) ka mixture lein.

blocks.alt: Ek haath tirchhe beaker se mixture glass rod (sheeshe ki dandi) ke saath filter paper wale funnel mein dal raha hai; funnel stand ke clamp mein hai aur neeche beaker mein filtrate ke qatre gir rahe hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.1: Filtration ka process (kitab ki Figure 15.1 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Is mixture ko distilled water mein dalein. Namak poore pani mein phail kar homogeneous mixture (har jagah ek jaisa mixture) bana deta hai. Is homogeneous mixture ko pani mein namak ka solution kehte hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki is picture par koi label nahi. Mixture ko seedha funnel mein nahi dalte balkay glass rod ke saath aahista dalte hain taake chhinte na urein. Funnel stand ke clamp mein laga hai; filter paper par ret (residue) ruk jati hai aur namak ka solution (filtrate) neeche beaker mein chala jata hai.

Is solution mein namak ko solute aur pani ko solvent kehte hain. Solution mein solvent woh component hai jo solute ke muqable mein zyada amount mein ho. Namak to pani mein ghaib ho jata hai, lekin doosra component, ret, hal nahi hoti aur kuch der baad solution ke bottom (tah) mein beth jati hai.

Upar wale solution se ret alag karne ke liye filtration istemal hoti hai. Yeh kai type ke filter media (filter karne wali cheezon) se ki ja sakti hai. Precipitate (solid particles) ki nature aur doosri baaton se tay hota hai ke kaun sa filter medium lena hai. Sab se aasan tareeqe do hain: filter paper se, ya filter crucible se.
